notes:
Inbound via blog post about low-latency inferencing; signed up for self-serve trial 2026-02-20. Early-stage fintech focused on merchant reconciliation + support automation.

Quick summary: they want to spin up a hosted API POC first (self-serve) to prototype a customer support assistant (chat) that ties into transaction metadata and an internal KB (embeddings). Also plan to use reranking for search results relevance. Cost sensitive — want to understand token economics and suggested batching/cache settings. Latency target: p95 < 150ms for short chat queries; throughput moderate (500-2k reqs/day initially).

Security asks: SOC2 report requested, SSO via SAML (Okta), audit logs and KMS integration for future Private offer. They are "VPC-curious" but willing to start on hosted API if SOC2 + SAML supported. Legal has a standard DPA in review.

Key quotes: "We want something we can ship quickly but not have to rebuild when we scale — eventually will need VPC or dedicated capacity." — Head of Product.

Technical note: dev team prefers open/quantizable models for cost (mentions Llama-family variants) but OK with Redwood-verified options. Wants quick sample for embeddings + chat flow, plus example reranking pipeline.

Sales sense: highly product-led motion; if POC shows good latency/cost, likely to move to reserved capacity next year. Small ARR initially, with potential for enterprise add-ons (observability + longer retention) in 12–18 months.

Stubs/links: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ response (drive), 2 call transcripts (fireflies ids), initial security questions email thread (gmail).
